articles.description: Capgemini has raised its revenue growth target for 2026 after strong third-quarter results driven by AI initiatives. Capgemini's focus on AI technology modernization is reshaping various sectors and enhancing client operations.

Texas Supreme Court Blocks Neighbours’ Broad Demand to Inspect Woman’s 14-Acre Homestead
articles.description: In a significant ruling, the Texas Supreme Court has sided with Pamela Bosco, affirming her right to keep her 14-acre homestead intact. The court denied neighbors’ requests for property inspections due to insufficient evidence of alleged violations. This ruling underscores the importance of legal processes in property disputes and confirms that establishing wrongdoing necessitates proper evidence gathering.

articles.title: Binance to resume withdrawals after recovering 95% of $6.3 billion crypto theft
articles.description: Binance has announced a phased resumption of cryptocurrency withdrawals following a significant heist of $6.3 billion. The exchange reported it has recovered 95% of the stolen digital assets, enabling this process. The remaining 5% consists of less liquid tokens, which may require additional time to source. The FBI is investigating the cyberattack, linking it to a North Korean hacking group named TraderTraitor.

articles.title: Apple reclaims world's most valuable company title as Nvidia slips amid AI investment concerns
articles.description: Apple has reclaimed the position of the world's most valuable company, surpassing Nvidia amid rising concerns. Both companies have seen their stock prices decline, with Apple falling 1.2 percent and Nvidia 4.2 percent. Significant investments in artificial intelligence by major firms have raised questions regarding long-term sustainability. Apple's limited capital expenditure on AI compared to rivals has attracted investor interest and boosted free cash flow projections.

articles.title: IIT Delhi Open House 2026 draws 4,500 visitors, showcases over 500 research presentations
articles.description: IIT Delhi Open House 2026: IIT Delhi organised the 19th edition of its Open House on October 31, 2026, showcasing more than 500 technological presentations across 10 research themes. The event featured over 100 prototype demonstrations, 225 research posters, 80 laboratory demonstrations and more than 90 student research talks. Around 4,500 visitors attended, including 3,000 school and college students. The programme also included alumni-led project evaluations, research awards and discussions on indigenous technology development and industry-academia collaboration.

articles.title: UPTET 2026: Allahabad High Court orders exclusion of two questions, directs UPESSC to revise scores for all candidates
articles.description: The Allahabad High Court has directed UPESSC to remove two disputed questions from the UPTET 2026 evaluation and recalculate scores based on 148 questions. The court has extended the relief to all similarly placed candidates, not just the petitioners, while clarifying that revised eligibility will not guarantee appointment in future teacher recruitment exercises.

articles.title: WBCHSE semester system under review: Will West Bengal bring back annual Class 11 and 12 exams?
articles.description: The West Bengal Council of Higher Secondary Education (WBCHSE) is reviewing concerns surrounding the four-semester examination system for Classes 11 and 12. Teachers and school heads have flagged limited classroom time, syllabus completion challenges and increased examination workload. However, no official decision has been announced on restoring the traditional annual examination pattern.

articles.title: ‘Irumudi’ makers receive labour department notice over child actor
articles.description: The Telangana labour department has issued a notice regarding concerns about Baby Nakshathra's participation in the shooting and promotional events for 'Irumudi'. The filmmakers are set to meet the department on November 4 to discuss issues such as work hours, payment, and safety protocols for the young actor. The department also seeks documentation on permissions and parental consent from the production team.

articles.title: Ritika Singh exposes fake Facebook account using her name
articles.description: Ritika Singh alerted her followers about a fraudulent Facebook page operating under her name. The page charges Rs 400 monthly subscriptions while falsely claiming to represent her. She clarified that her only official social media account is her verified Instagram profile. Ritika requested her followers to report the imitation page to avoid further confusion.
